title: 申万宏源蒋静：关注中国国产算力与AI芯片机会
speaker: Jinsheng Jing

segments.en: I think the AI trade is generally going upward, doing the big trend, one for sure.
segments.zh: 我认为AI交易总体呈上升趋势，大趋势是确定的。

segments.en: And we have to recommend, or we have to point it out, I think for the second half of the year, we also need to pay more attention to the Chinese computing power capex trend.
segments.zh: 我们必须指出，下半年我们还需要更多关注中国算力资本开支趋势。

segments.en: We can see that with the combination, with DeepSeq and the Huawei shapes, this might, I would say, acknowledge the enthusiasm for the packers of the Chinese domestic computing power.
segments.zh: 我们看到，结合DeepSeq和华为的形态，这可能会激发对中国国产算力封装的热情。

segments.en: So in terms of the market, that we can also find more opportunities on this side, not only just those opportunities driven by the big names in the US market.
segments.zh: 所以在市场方面，我们也能在这一侧找到更多机会，而不仅仅是美国市场大公司驱动的机会。

segments.en: Tell us some of those names. What stands out here? What should foreign investors be looking at in as far as the Chinese domestic markets are concerned?
segments.zh: 请告诉我们一些具体的公司。哪些比较突出？外国投资者在中国国内市场应该关注什么？

segments.en: Like Han Wuji, like those chips are actually driven by the domestic capex, like Han Wuji, and some also from the Chinese market, the Hong Kong market.
segments.zh: 比如寒武纪，这些芯片实际上是由国内资本开支驱动的，还有来自中国内地市场和香港市场的一些新公司。
